about.metaDescription: Who I am, what I work on in geomatics, and the tools I use day to day.
about.heading: About
about.bio1: I work at the intersection of geomatics and technical drafting. Concretely: I spend my days turning territorial data — surveys, imagery, municipal databases, CAD drawings — into something legible that people can decide on.
about.bio2: What interests me most is where the two chains meet. CAD describes a drawing, GIS describes a territory; making them talk to each other means rebuilding meaning, not just converting files. It is the subject that comes up most often in this notebook.
about.bio3: I live in Quebec and work in both French and English.
